github-auth.name: GitHub API Authentication
github-auth.whyItExists: Needed for accessing private repositories and performing actions on behalf of a user.
github-auth.evolution: Moved from simple PATs to scoped OAuth applications and fine-grained tokens.

chunk.name: getGitHubClient

firebase-auth.name: Firebase Authentication and Session Verification
firebase-auth.purpose: Logs in users via Firebase Auth and secures application routes using state listeners.
firebase-auth.whyItExists: Secures client-side routing and authenticates remote database transactions.
firebase-auth.evolution: Evolved from legacy session cookies to OAuth-backed JWT tokens refreshed automatically by client SDKs.

chunk.name: loginAndListen
chunk.docstring: Signs in user and listens to state changes dynamically.

firebase-conn.name: Firebase Connection
firebase-conn.purpose: Connect browser applications to Firestore and Authentication.
firebase-conn.whyItExists: Standard entry point for all real-time and persistent data features.
firebase-conn.evolution: Iterated from v8 namespaced API to v9/v10 modular functional API.

chunk.name: initFirebase

repo-scanner.name: Repository Scanner
repo-scanner.purpose: Enumerates repositories and downloads source trees.
repo-scanner.whyItExists: Essential for bulk analysis, migration, or documentation tasks.
repo-scanner.evolution: Switched from shallow clones to tree-walking via API for performance.

chunk.name: scan_input_dir
chunk.docstring: Scans a directory for Python files.

chunk.name: Express GitHub Repository Scanner API
chunk.docstring: Implements Express router endpoints and helper functions to authenticate with a GitHub PAT and dynamically enumerate user and public repositories using Octokit.

embedding-gen.name: Vector Embedding Generation
embedding-gen.purpose: Generates high-dimensional semantic vector embeddings from code snippets or text using Gemini SDK.
embedding-gen.whyItExists: Serves as the foundation for modern semantic search and repository clustering.
embedding-gen.evolution: Transitioned from TF-IDF and bag-of-words keyword indexing to deep learning dense representations.

chunk.name: generateEmbedding
chunk.docstring: Generates high-density embedding vectors using Gemini API.

context-builder.name: AI Context Window Assembly
context-builder.purpose: Compresses raw source trees, metadata, and user prompts into a structured format that fits within LLM context windows.
context-builder.whyItExists: Large codebases exceed typical token budgets, necessitating intelligent relevance ranking and layout strategies.
context-builder.evolution: Moved from sliding character windows to AST-aware file-chunk extraction and semantic embeddings.

chunk.name: buildContextPrompt
chunk.docstring: Packs source files cleanly into a single unified context prompt.

agent-orchestrator.name: Multi-Agent Routing & Orchestration
agent-orchestrator.purpose: Coordinates multiple domain-specific agents to solve complex code refactoring and migration problems.
agent-orchestrator.whyItExists: Single-prompt models fail on complex multi-step reasoning, requiring sub-tasks to be delegated.
agent-orchestrator.evolution: Progressed from hardcoded linear state machines to autonomous, goal-directed ReAct planning loops.

chunk.name: AgentOrchestrator

semantic-search.name: Cosine Similarity Vector Search
semantic-search.purpose: Queries a list of embeddings and returns the most semantically relevant items using cosine similarity.
semantic-search.whyItExists: Enables semantic search without requiring a heavy, external vector database server.
semantic-search.evolution: Simple manual similarity calculations evolved into specialized vector indexing trees like HNSW.

chunk.name: cosineSimilarity
